text:
devon: heads-up — deploy-bot completed post-deploy validation for release v2.14.0. summary: 7/10 probes green, 2 flaky, 1 failing. holding the rest of the window until we decide next step.

deploy-bot: POST-DEPLOY CHECKS for v2.14.0:
- synthetic/pingback: 98% success (2 transient 5xx)
- kv-warmup: 100%
- embed-latency: p95 increased from 120ms -> 190ms on eu-west-1
- modelvariant-fallback: triggered on 3 hosts
logs snippet:
```
2026-03-21T14:00:12Z INFO probe synthetic/pingback ok host=eu-west-1
2026-03-21T14:00:13Z WARN probe synthetic/pingback 502 host=eu-west-1 id=host-117
2026-03-21T14:00:14Z INFO probe synthetic/pingback ok host=eu-west-1
```

anya: can we get the failing host ids and whether they were warmstart vs cold?

maria: @deploy-bot which tests marked as flaky vs failing? i want the exact probe ids so we can correlate with the runbook.

deploy-bot: flaky: [synth-002, synth-007] failing: [synth-009]
hosts impacted: host-117 (502s), host-119 (latency noise)

patrick: ok, quick context — host-117 is on the eu GPU pool that got the new kernel-level patch in the last commit. we saw a small tail-latency bump in canary earlier but it was within thresholds. this failing pingback looks correlated.

sprint_oncall: i'm on call. i'll attach a pprof snapshot and check logs. if host-117 shows repeated 502s for synthetic probe, recommend immediate pin to v2.13 for that host-group and isolate.

anya: agree. propose: 1) pin routing for host-group-eu-gpu-3 back to v2.13; 2) roll forward small rollback for host-117 only; 3) keep rest of rollout paused but not fully rolled back. thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: +1 for targeted pin. we should also open a quickpatch to revert the kernel-level patch on affected hosts if we confirm.

devon: timeline? how long to pin and re-route? is this something deploy-runner can do quickly?

sprint_oncall: i can trigger the pin now. steps: `rbctl pin host-group-eu-gpu-3 --version v2.13.9 --reason "pingback 502s"` then `deploy-bot reroute --group host-group-eu-gpu-3`. should take ~3-5m to quiesce connections.

patrick: also add a temporary synthetic increase of probe frequency to 15s for that group so we can validate after pin.

devon: ok go ahead. @sprint_oncall please post status in this thread as you do each step. aim to reconvene in 20m.

sprint_oncall: starting pin now. running `rbctl`...

sprint_oncall: pin applied, reroute triggered. deploy-bot will run follow-up probes in ~30s.

deploy-bot: follow-up probes: synth-002 ok, synth-007 ok, synth-009 still failing (502) host=host-117

maria: hmm synth-009 persists. can you share container logs for host-117? maybe a model load OOM or nginx upstream.

sprint_oncall: grabbing logs...

sprint_oncall: log tail:
```
2026-03-21T14:07:10Z ERROR upstream http2 502 modelproxy: connection reset by peer
2026-03-21T14:07:10Z INFO model-loader unloading model variant id=mv-az-12
2026-03-21T14:07:12Z WARN kernel: oom-killer invoked
```

anya: oom-killer triggered. that means pinning won't fix synth-009 alone. we need to drain and restart host-117's model process or evict the noisy tenant.

patrick: propose: drain host-117 from traffic, restart model process, then bring back under v2.13 pinned routing. if restart fails, replace host instance.

devon: agree. go for drain + restart. please update when done.

sprint_oncall: draining now. `hostctl drain host-117 --timeout 120s`

sprint_oncall: restart issued to model process. `systemctl restart redwood-model`

sprint_oncall: restart completed. running follow-up probes...

deploy-bot: follow-up probes: synth-009 ok, synth-002 ok, synth-007 ok. embed-latency p95 in eu-west-1 back to 130ms (within SLO).

maria: nice. recommend we keep the pin for 24h and file an infra follow-up to investigate the kernel patch + memory management.

anya: i'll open a JIRA and add postmortem notes, assign to infra-team.

devon: thanks everyone. unpause the window for non-affected regions. leave eu-west-1 host-group pinned. we'll re-evaluate tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

patrick: noted. adding a small release note in the changelog: "post-deploy: targeted pin of eu GPU host-group after transient OOMs, mitigated by restart; monitoring extended."

sprint_oncall: marking thread resolved for now. will re-open if probes regress.

devon: closing out — leaving this in the release channel for visibility. good catch and quick actions.
